hook.name: CurbHook
hook.description: Curb: a LULD-style circuit breaker for the CURB/IMD pool, launched through Identity MD. Refuses a swap that would end more than 1000 ticks from a 5-minute time-weighted reference and further from it (a swap toward the reference always passes); a price held at the band's edge for 15 s halts the pool both ways for at most 15 min, then it reopens on its own. No fees, no deltas, no liquidity callbacks, not upgradeable.
